tasks.title: Stealth Technology
paras: Stealth technology is designed to make military assets, like aircraft, ships, and missiles, harder to detect by radar. This goal is achieved by reducing the reflection and emission of radar waves. One method involves using materials that absorb radar waves. Another method shapes the surfaces of these assets to deflect radar waves away from the radar receiver.

The F-117 Nighthawk, developed during the 1970s, was the first operational stealth aircraft. Its angular design made it difficult for radar to detect, though it had limitations. Subsequent advancements led to aircraft like the B-2 Spirit bomber, which features smoother surfaces and radar-absorbing paint. These improvements not only enhanced stealth but also influenced designs of other military vehicles. Stealth technology extends beyond aircraft. Modern naval vessels employ angled surfaces and radar-absorbent coatings to minimize their radar signature. Submarines utilize stealth through hulls that are designed to reduce sonar detection.

Despite its advantages, the complexity and cost of stealth technology limit its availability to only a few countries. Ongoing research aims to improve effectiveness and affordability, potentially expanding its usage in future military applications. However, these advancements also raise concerns about an escalating arms race and the ethical implications of increasingly undetectable weaponry.

questions.stem: All of the following are true about stealth technology EXCEPT:

options.A: It reduces radar reflection and emission.
options.B: It is used in aircraft, ships, and missiles.
options.C: It is affordable for many countries.
options.D: It frequently involves the use of radar-absorbing materials.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节排除题 原文定位：the complexity and cost…limit its availability to only a few countries 解析：隐形技术造价高昂，只有少数国家能用，并非很多国家都负担得起。 选项分析： A. 减少雷达反射和辐射 —— 第一段原文，排除 B. 用于飞机、舰船、导弹 —— 首句原文，排除 C. 很多国家都负担得起 —— 与原文 only a few 相反，正确 D. 常使用吸波材料 —— 第一段有提及，排除

questions.stem: What does the passage indicate about the F-117 Nighthawk?

options.A: It was developed after the B-2 Spirit bomber.
options.B: It used radar-absorbing paint like the B-2 Spirit did.
options.C: It was the first stealth aircraft to be operational.
options.D: It featured advanced materials for stealth.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：The F-117 Nighthawk…was the first operational stealth aircraft. 解析：F-117 是第一款正式投入使用的隐形战机。 选项分析： A. 比 B-2 研发更晚 —— 原文 1970 年代先有 F-117，顺序颠倒，错误 B. 和 B-2 一样使用吸波涂料 —— 原文 B-2 才有，F-117 是棱角外形，错误 C. 第一款投入服役的隐形战机 —— 完全对应原文，正确 D. 拥有先进隐形材料 —— 原文只提外形设计，未提先进材料，错误

questions.stem: Why does the author mention submarines in the passage?

options.A: To help demonstrate that stealth technology is being used in ways that do not involve aircraft
options.B: To argue that stealth technology from submarines has been used in other types of naval vessels
options.C: To describe the differences between modern naval vessels and older naval vessels
options.D: To discuss ongoing research in sonar detection

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：Stealth technology extends beyond aircraft…Submarines utilize stealth… 解析：举例潜艇，证明隐形技术不只应用在飞机上，还拓展到其他军事装备。 选项分析： A. 说明隐形技术不只是用在飞机上 —— 贴合段落逻辑，正确 B. 潜艇技术被用于其他舰船 —— 原文无技术借鉴，错误 C. 对比新旧舰船差异 —— 无对比内容，错误 D. 讨论声呐探测的前沿研究 —— 偏离举例目的，错误

questions.stem: The word "potentially" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：词汇题 原文定位：potentially expanding its usage in future military applications 解析：potentially 意为潜在地、有可能。 选项分析： A. quickly 迅速地 —— 不符 B. greatly 极大地 —— 不符 C. easily 轻易地 —— 不符 D. possibly 可能地 —— 同义匹配，正确

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the purpose of the third paragraph?

options.A: Paragraph 3 provides examples of stealth technology beyond aircraft.
options.B: Paragraph 3 discusses some drawbacks of advancing stealth technology.
options.C: Paragraph 3 argues that stealth technology should be shared among different countries.
options.D: Paragraph 3 explains why recent advancements in stealth technology were successful.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：段落目的题 原文定位：cost limit availability /concerns about arms race and ethical implications 解析：第三段讲隐形技术成本高、普及受限，还带来军备竞赛、伦理隐患，属于弊端与负面影响。 选项分析： A. 举飞机以外的隐形技术例子 —— 是第二段内容，错误 B. 讨论隐形技术发展带来的一些弊端 —— 贴合第三段主旨，正确 C. 主张各国共享技术 —— 原文无此意，错误 D. 解释技术进步为何成功 —— 第三段重在问题与隐患，不是成功原因，错误
